headline: On November 15, 2020: Hamilton claims seventh title
captionCards: First driver to match Schumacher’s record of 7 titles
instagramCaption:
Lewis Hamilton wins Turkish GP, secures record-tying seventh title.

He becomes the first driver to match Michael Schumacher’s seven world championships.
This milestone came at the 2020 Turkish Grand Prix, held in Istanbul.
Hamilton also holds the records for most wins (106), pole positions (105), and podiums (209).
His achievement remains a benchmark in Formula One history.
